p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference-3/play/users/u076/system/state/workspace/programs/task-efc51e9f.py')

source='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = next(c for c, n in Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).items() if n == 0) if False else None
    # Divider color is the color occupying complete internal rows and columns.
    row_bars = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    col_bars = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    divider = grid[row_bars[0]][0] if row_bars else grid[0][col_bars[0]]
    row_edges = [-1] + row_bars + [h]
    col_edges = [-1] + col_bars + [w]
    rs = [(row_edges[i] + 1, row_edges[i+1]) for i in range(len(row_edges)-1)]
    cs = [(col_edges[i] + 1, col_edges[i+1]) for i in range(len(col_edges)-1)]
    marker = 5
    colors = [v for row in grid for v in row if v != divider and v != marker]
    background = Counter(colors).most_common(1)[0][0] if colors else 0
    return [[1 if sum(grid[r][c] == marker for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1)) > 1 else background
             for c0,c1 in cs] for r0,r1 in rs]
'''
